# Glossary

## Manufacturing terms
- **OEE** — Overall Equipment Effectiveness: availability × performance × quality. Brandt's
  headline productivity metric; target **85%**, currently ~70% blended.
- **Takt time** — the pace of production needed to meet customer demand (available time ÷ demand).
- **Cycle time** — actual time to complete one unit at a station; must be ≤ takt time.
- **MRP** — Material Requirements Planning: the logic that schedules purchasing and production
  from the bill of materials and demand. Brandt's legacy MRP is being replaced by the
  [Compass ERP](../projects/erp-modernization.md).
- **Lead time** — elapsed time from order to delivery (or from PO to receipt for a supplier input).
- **Scrap** — material/parts rejected and thrown out; **scrap rate** is scrap ÷ total produced.
- **WIP** — Work In Process: partially finished goods on the floor.
- **HPU** — Hydraulic Power Unit; the Greenville plant's main product.
- **OTD** — On-Time Delivery: share of orders shipped by the promised date.
- **TRIR** — Total Recordable Incident Rate; the standard OSHA safety metric.
- **LOTO** — Lockout/Tagout; the energy-control safety procedure implicated in the Rockford
  citation.
- **PM** — in a plant context, Preventive Maintenance (not project manager).

## Internal shorthand
- **The network** — all four plants collectively.
- **Compass** — internal name for the ERP modernization program.
- **The Family** — the Brandt family owners; distinct from Ridgeline (the PE minority holder).
